caption: The drawing features a single object centrally positioned on a plain, light-colored background. The object is a dark brown or black metallic piece with a symmetrical design. It has a small, cylindrical top section that appears to be a socket or holder. Below the top, the body widens and features two horizontally extended, spiraled elements on each side, resembling stylized arms or fins. The lower portion of the object is a diamond-shaped blade with a pointed end, and at its center, there is a small, heart-shaped cutout. Subtle shading and fine lines have been used to depict the texture and contours, giving the object a three-dimensional appearance. At the bottom right corner of the drawing, the name "Syd. Roberts" is written in small, neat letters.
title: Pipe
